protocol.population: First legal naturally barrel-containing draft pair from 128 pre-reserved disjoint candidates per family. Four fixed opponent draft styles; each has seven complete 27 map/own/opponent-doctrine cycles. Real native paid public Setup, legal splitting and placement; no forced offers, artifacts, picks or spending.
protocol.primary: Equal-weight whole-family mean entrant score(mixture)-score(stock v10). Scores 0/0.5/1. All four matched cases stay together. Inspect aggregate outcomes only after both hosts complete.

confidence.bootstrap: 20000 uint32 xorshift32 whole-family resamples; independent Bun integer half-point reconstruction

protocol.secondary: Naive v1 and accepted pair contrasts remain descriptive and cannot substitute for the primary comparator. No multiplicity selection among candidates.
protocol.assignment: Within each 189-family style block, cycles 0..4 of 27 go local, cycles 5..6 go Puffalo. Entire family/all four cases/all four arms stay on that host. No reassignment after combat begins.
protocol.cold: Before fresh combat, six fixed existing functional cases (indices 0,8,16,24,28,32) reproduce all four arms locally and on Puffalo. Require exact consumed input/full trace/score/forecast counts and witnesses. Fresh cold repeats are selected by fixed style/map/own-doctrine cells before first strength fight.
protocol.fixedTermination: Freeze a common absolute cutoff before either shard starts, at most 2.5 hours after strength registration. No automatic retry, extension, source/model/gate change, outcome-selected subset or incomplete-bank promotion.
protocol.progress: Complete case/fight counts and health only while running; no interim score-based decisions.
protocol.afterPassing: Separately register quiet serial full-fight and complete-decision cost within +10%, then at least 756 independent fresh confirmation families. No cost/confirmation channels allocated here. No automatic serving promotion or deployment from qualification.

metadataClarification: The generic allocator receipt retained an old qualificationOrConfirmationReserved:false field from the previous development allocator. This explicit qualification allocation supersedes that phase label before any fresh combat; seed bytes, gates, source and eligibility are unchanged.
futureExclusion: Expand every scanned preimage, including rejected and unused candidates, into seed+i and native permuteRankedDraftSeed(seed+i) for i=0..7. Do not collect only selected fights.
independentSeedAudit: Required before strength registration/first combat; outcome bank remains unopened.
